notes:
Background: SparrowRidge builds an intelligent curation layer for mid-market e-commerce platforms. They ingest catalog + behavioral signals and run a two-stage retrieval + rerank pipeline. Interested in Redwood hosted API to run an initial 2-week POC, then move to Dedicated if unit economics and latency look good.

Key asks from last demo: 
- Dedicated pricing for reserved pool (baseline throughput 200 req/s, burst to 800 req/s).
- Reranking endpoint: need explicit support for offline scoring API (batch scoring), and a low-latency online rerank path (99th pctl < 120ms for top-10).
- Quality workflow: want eval harness integrated with Redwood Optimize to run periodic ndcg/precision checks on human-labeled eval sets.
- Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama-3 family or similar) with quantization options; also want fallback to smaller, cheaper variants under load.

POC specifics (customer-provided):
- Eval set: ~10k user queries with binary relevance labels + graded labels for top-5. Human labeling done by internal team.
- Offline scoring: need S3-style batch import + ability to compute and return per-query score vector (for downstream A/B).
- Logging/observability: token-level cost breakdown, trace IDs for reranks, per-model latency histograms.

Customer quotes from demo: "We need deterministic rerank scores for offline experiments — small score shifts break the business metrics." + "If hosted looks good we want to lock Dedicated for Q3 release."

Commercial: Rough ARR target $150k-$200k/year if Dedicated pricing meets cost-per-1000-requests target. Finance asked for a 12-month commit option.

Security/legal: Will require SOC2 + SSO (SAML) and KMS integration; compliance team started questionnaire (linked SEC-7891).

Risks: Their offline eval harness demands exact reproducibility; will push back on model variant fallbacks if behaviour differs. Also sensitive to tokenization differences (existing infra uses SentencePiece variants).

use_case_summary: Two-stage retrieval + rerank for e-comm curation. Batch offline scoring for experiments and a deterministic low-latency online rerank endpoint for production personalization and search. Priorities: stable quality metrics (ndcg), predictable cost, and regional data residency.
recent_poc_findings: Hosted POC shows promise: good ndcg improvements with tuned rerank model. p99 latency slightly above target (140ms) — ops suggested tuning batching and KV cache. Offline batch scoring works via S3 import but needs CSV schema standardization.
